_comment: The first polymorphic class. Registering a ctor or dtor here is what makes tools/asm.py ask
asm_vtables to hand ??_7mmCityInfo@@6B@ over from .rdata to the C++ table.
??_GmmCityInfo@@UAEPAXI@Z is deliberately NOT listed. It is the scalar deleting destructor,
declared in no header and generated by MSVC from the class definition alone; asm.py picks it
up from handover.strip_procs instead. Listing it here as well would be harmless but
misleading - nothing in the C++ corresponds to it.
